revision_reason: Correct the pre-result method surface by adding the already prepared official-source adapters MemoryOS, MemGAS, and Hindsight, plus visible NA rows for Memory-R1, APEX-MEM, and ACL 2026 LightMem whose executable official code is unavailable. This closes the gap between the recent-method roadmap and the actual comparison templates before any local main result is admitted.

inherited_contract.row_unit: one locally reproduced method under the same frozen protocol

recent_same_track_public_candidates.identity_rule: The deprecated omnimem-agent alias is represented only by canonical wma-omni-simplemem and is never executed as a duplicate row.

admission_and_display_policy.internal_master: Keep all 30 rows visible, including blocked and proposed rows.
admission_and_display_policy.paper_projection: Populate numeric cells only from complete same-protocol locally reproduced results with terminal acceptance and verified artifacts.
admission_and_display_policy.blocked_rows: Keep blocked rows as explicit NA status rows; never substitute source-reported numbers.
admission_and_display_policy.official_numbers: Official paper values remain in the separate source-reported evidence layer and never fill a local result cell.
admission_and_display_policy.failed_runs: Keep the method visible, preserve the failure evidence, and do not silently remove its row or samples.
admission_and_display_policy.proposed_method: AgentEnhance remains locked until the public baseline gates are accepted.

claim_policy.overall_sota: Requires an accepted local AgentEnhance result against all nonblocked required comparators on the same protocol and must show all guardrails.
claim_policy.axis_or_slice_best: May be claimed only on a predeclared inherited axis or slice, with its exact scope and denominator, and must not be relabeled overall SOTA.
claim_policy.no_guarantee: The table is designed to reveal defensible best results if they occur; it does not guarantee or manufacture a favorable result.

prohibited_actions: removing a recent candidate after observing results
conflating the three distinct LightMem-named projects
executing a blocked source as if official code existed
filling a local cell with an official-paper value
hiding failed samples, seeds, methods, guardrails, or unfavorable metrics
claiming overall SOTA from one favorable slice or efficiency axis
